name: Benchmark for Quantitative Evaluation of Assisted Object Segmentation Methods to Image Sequences
description: A benchmark and evaluation protocol for quantitatively assessing assisted object segmentation methods on image sequences (video frames).
evaluation_method: mean IoU (Intersection over Union) / pixel-wise accuracy
reputation: An older, specialized academic benchmark used in assisted/interactive segmentation literature, with limited mainstream adoption compared with larger video-segmentation benchmarks.
notes: Small, dated (2008) dataset and protocol; non-LLM benchmark; limited contemporary adoption and potential domain shift relative to modern video datasets.
